thread.title: Coca-Cola: A Great Blue Chip - The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO)

author: Faloh Investment
title: Coca-Cola: A Great Blue Chip - The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO)
text:
Welcome!
In this article, we review The Coca-Cola Company's ( KO ) business results. The data suggests this stock has everything it needs to rally in the long term - the chart says it might tank in the short term. The question is, who's going to make the money?
KO's Downward Trend In Free Cash Flow Reverses 5 Year Chart: Price (blue line), Free Cash Flow (orange), and Total Shares Outstanding (green)
KO data by YCharts
Runrate figures are stated based on the trailing twelve months of reported data unless described otherwise.
Reviewing this chart, shorts trying to ride KO down are fighting against the long-term trend up displayed by this stock. KO raked in a huge $5.5B free cash flow, and the rate of free cash flow is on an uptrend per the most recent figures (the golden V located at the chart's bottom right).
KO Revenue (TTM) data by YCharts
By the chart, KO's revenue has shrunk from a high of $43B held through 2013 before entering a steady decline to the most recent figures measuring $32B in revenue. The hidden cause of the decline in sales, by at least several billion dollars, is the company no longer receives revenues on substantial bottling operations Coca-Cola spun off to smaller companies such as the Coca-Cola Bottling Company Consolidated (NASDAQ: COKE ).
Despite the drops in revenue, there's no clear downtrend in sales of the company's products. Worldwide demand for beverages isn't shrinking and KO has remained a champion supplier to myriad end markets for many years.
Short-term Price To Earnings of 23 Reflects KO's Dominating Performance Over The S&P 500 KO PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts
In the chart, we're seeing KO's forward price to earnings ratio increase as the market has become more enthusiastic about KO since Spring, rallying 4.5% and delivering a 9% outperformance relative to the S&P 500 Index. During the trailing twelve months, KO has shown strength relative to more than a few of the biggest S&P 500 components such as Facebook ( FB ), Apple, Inc. ( AAPL ), and Amazon.com, Inc. ( AMZN ).
KO's Profit Rate Climbing Rapidly KO Profit Margin (TTM) data by YCharts
Net profitability indicators are turning up strong results, a very favorable trend for longs. As the company's profit margin converges on its path toward exceeding its long-term median, we may see growing EPS numbers, in line with improvements in annual net income. And all of these successes may occur despite the revenues diminished due to the bottling business' refranchising successes.
KO Lost Over $3B Market Capitalization In Five Days Despite the recent financial statements from the company being plainly replete with information reporting great income performance and steady buyback progress, a lot of investors have been spooked out of KO due to their recent steep decline in per share value:
KO Price data by YCharts
Three billion dollars in market capitalization was wiped out in just five days!
It's pretty clear KO is trading down into prices in line with shorts' recent interests. Well look out, shorts. Improvements in reported profitability and buybacks taking place since mid-2009 may help KO present the reported earnings power longs crave.
Concluding Remarks The next set of financials are going to be a doozy - the big 10-K Annual Report for the fiscal year through Dec. 31st, 2018. Typically, the company files 10-Ks during the second week of February.
KO's operations are a lot slimmer after the bottling factory spin-offs, so the company will likely return to its median profitability of 15% and may enjoy a higher average profit rate going forward. Expenses go down a lot when you don't have to maintain factories.
Considering the average annual buyback inching along at 1%, I expect operating performance to turn in good results and reveal a growing cash balance. Pressure on the market to reverse its negative sentiment may lead to a rally in KO at some point in the future.
Overall, the company appears to be accumulating a large cash horde of $9B which will provide opportunities for the company to further create shareholder value through diligent capital allocation.
KO's share price looks like any ball game right now. We're going to continue to see volatility in this stock clear through earnings in February. There's no doubt that KO appears to be in a position to steadily accumulate value thanks to their strong asset base and brands.
